description: Repairs r-cursor-1/id-bookmark-shape: the six Bookmark assignments ran one after another on one dynaset, so the failed four-zero-byte assignment left no current row and confounded the effect of the later ones, and the first (empty array) could not be told from a no-op. For each constant [empty byte array, four zero bytes, empty string, Long 1, Null, Empty] a NEW dynaset on T is opened and moved to ID 2 (MoveNext); read BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition, the ID and Bookmark; assign Bookmark the constant; read Errors; read BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition, the ID and Bookmark again; close. As a control for a no-op, a new dynaset first moves 2 rows (Move 2) and reads Bookmark, then MoveFirst, reads the state, and has Bookmark assigned the four bytes 02 02 00 00 (the dynaset Bookmark that r-cursor-1b read for the third row, used here as an input only), then the same Errors and state reads. Asks, for each constant on its own object, whether the assignment changes the position or leaves no current row, and how it is refused. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
